text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is Falco's full power...
Everything Falco has to give right now!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How... was it!?
Everyone... was Falco sparkling out there?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Uwooooh, Falco~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
It was so super sparkly!
Waaaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So many wonderful smiles...
Aha, some of them are even crying...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now☆
I can see all of your faces clearly~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Smile properly,
keep smiling until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: See you again~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon took in the applause from her fans and waved with a bright smile.
There wasn't a trace of hesitation in her presence...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Thank youuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is completely re~vived☆
Shalalala~♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I made you worry,
but I'm okay now!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
It really is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Looking at everyone's faces,
I understood... what you were saying, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Everyone's faces gazing at Falco with sparkling eyes."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Today, I could see so clearly.
Truly... for the first time in so long.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Since I can get everyone that hyped up,
Falco's definitely sparkling bright☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: At your final Tokyo Daishoten, you'll surely shine even brighter than today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's make it an absolutely, positively amazing stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having regained her form, Smart Falcon
seems full of energy and ready for her
final grand stage, the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to propose an event that would give her
an even bigger push forward.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A "Christmas Handshake Event"...?
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how much she captivates her fans...
I was planning to hold an event where she could experience that firsthand in person.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa~, that sounds interesting!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, we've never held a fan event on a grand scale before, have we?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
See, after all, Falco is
'the Umadol you can meet on the streetâ'âª

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, that doesn't even matter!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do it, let's do it!
Christmas event time♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I hope every single one of our fans comes!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, ahead of the final objective, the "Tokyo Daishoten"...
it was decided that a fan event
would be held.
